description: WindMar provides an archived maritime route-optimisation and vessel-performance reference implementation. The provider is WindMar. Geographical and temporal coverage: The open repository is frozen at version 0.1.5; users supply weather credentials and voyage reports for configured routes. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Apache-2.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The provider states that newer calibrated models and routing engines continue on a private commercial line; those features are not included in this open record. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
